BrandStory.headline: The Beginning. Where the Perfume Was Born
BrandStory.body:
In ancient Egypt, perfume was not a luxury.
It was an offering to the gods, a memory for kings, and one of the secrets of immortality.
From the blue lotus, myrrh, and frankincense,
the Egyptians drew the first scent ever told.
And now, it rests in your hands.
